brand.name: Monthly Touch OS
brand.vibe: Professional, modern, slightly futuristic, agency/SaaS operations vibe

mono.usage: Data points, integration IDs, timers, health scores

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability)
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for complex views
layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first responsive. Use subgrids where nested layout density is required. Avoid padding overload in data tables.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Crystal Glass - bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 saturate-150
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Grid Borders pattern - flat background (#121A2F), 1px subtle border (#1E293B), no heavy drop shadows. Hover: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
surfaces_and_micro_themes.active_states: The 'Tracing Beam' - subtle glowing borders for active meeting or recording states, blur-md behind for light bleed.

components_strategy.general: Shadcn/UI components heavily customized for dark navy theme. Strip default Vercel look. Write code in .js / .jsx (not TypeScript).
components_strategy.buttons: Flat, text-white, primary color bg (#3FA9F5). Sharp or slightly rounded edges (rounded-md). robust focus states (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/50).
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use custom tooltip with glassmorphism. Lines/bars use primary and secondary colors.
components_strategy.tables: Dense, text-sm. Hover on rows: bg-white/5. Sticky headers with crystal glass effect.
components_strategy.badges: Subtle background opacity (bg-opacity-20) with solid text color. e.g., bg-[#2FE0C2]/20 text-[#2FE0C2] for Health=Good.

page_specific_patterns.roster_dashboard: Modified F-pattern. Core metric (Account Health) top-left. Avatar list in grid.
page_specific_patterns.meeting_mode: Split screen layout. Timer and Agenda on left (sticky), Meeting Brief and Transcript capture on right.
page_specific_patterns.integration_settings: Bento grid of 12+ floating glass tiles. Use logo icons with status indicator dot (Green/Red) in top right of each tile.
page_specific_patterns.doc_hub: Two-column layout: sidebar navigation for SOPs/Checklists, main content area utilizing typography hierarchy.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Explicit text color changes.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered fade-up (Framer Motion) for client roster and integration lists.
motion_and_interactions.meeting_mode: Pulse animation (opacity shift) for active timer or recording state.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, matching text size or primary/secondary colors for emphasis.

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant. Use text-shadow on text over images/gradients. Never use pure transparent backgrounds under text.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-meeting-btn').

images.description: Abstract dark navy texture with very subtle, diffuse volumetric light bleed in bright blue. Used for login or empty states.
Modern tech abstract visual representing data integrations, floating glass tiles on dark navy. For empty states or docs hero.
Business professional avatars for roster dashboard client representatives.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors (#0A0E1A background, #3FA9F5 primary, #2FE0C2 secondary). Never invert light UI for dark mode; design dark-first.
Use ONLY JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all components, do NOT use TypeScript.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for icons to give a premium technical look.
Implement the layout with the 'Control Room' grid strategy. Dashboards must look dense and data-rich.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key informational areas have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Use 'Outfit' for headings, 'Figtree' for body text, and 'JetBrains Mono' for numbers/data.
Create a navigation header with Crystal Glass effect (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10) over scrolling content.
Do not use generic teal (#1B93A4). Use the specified brand teal (#2FE0C2) carefully for health scores, success states, or data accents.
Integrate the provided generated background and avatar images in appropriate placeholder locations instead of gray boxes.
Ensure inputs and textareas (like for Meeting Transcript upload) have distinct borders and focus states to stand out on dark backgrounds.
